what_it_checks: Integrated-family budget traversal across a grid boundary, UTC hour boundary and calendar closure.
derivation: Section 4.2 consumes intensity segment by segment. With unit intensity, a budget of 3/2 consumes 1/4 before the grid boundary, 1/4 before the UTC-hour boundary, zero through the closed interval, then the remaining 1 at the next open interval. The elapsed offset is 1/4 + 1/4 + 3 + 1 = 9/2 = 4.5 seconds. Thus the closure advances time but spends no budget and the resolved parent is one second after reopen.
